title: refactor(app-shell,data-objectstack): one authority each for MetadataTypeStatus and UserDataAdapter (objectui#6349, batch 9)
body:
Refs #6349 (batch 9)

Clause-②: yes

Batch 9 of the one-authority burn-down, on claim `6092135020` (seat `domain:ui#3`, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8`). *(Round 1.)* Two of the claim's three rows converge, so `KNOWN_COLLISIONS` goes from 13 rows to 11. Both were one thing declared twice, so app-shell re-points at the package it already depends on. Types, comments and changeset prose only: no runtime behaviour changes, and no emitted JavaScript changes.

*(Round 1, answered in round 2 above.)* The third row, **`AppShellProps`, is stopped with measured options** (see "The stopped row"). It is two meanings, and its only workable rename removes a name that a type-checked document reads through the `@object-ui/app-shell` entry. That is the claim's stop condition, so this PR leaves the row in the ledger untouched and the seat decides.

## Round 2 (head `3e1e1375a`): all three rows converge

Brought up to round 2 by the seat (`domain:ui` seat 3). The round-1 text below is kept and marked where round 2 supersedes it.

- **`AppShellProps`:** ruled **A** by the seat's claim amendment `6092402348` on objectui#6349, under the card's remedy and batch 5's precedent, with the maintainer's veto window open. app-shell's declaration is now **`MinimalAppShellProps`**, published at the app-shell root in place of `AppShellProps`. layout keeps the general name.
  - `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`'s two blocks follow, and the three layout tests' comments and one failure message name the new type.
  - ⛔ No component rename: both `AppShell` value names stay.
- **`KNOWN_COLLISIONS`:** 13 → **10** rows.
- **Published surface:** app-shell 258 = 258 names, with `AppShellProps` out and `MinimalAppShellProps` in, members identical; that swap is the only change to the name set. react, data-objectstack and layout are unchanged.
- **Emitted output:** no `.js` or `.css` file differs.
- **Consumer probe:** the old name fails with TS2305, and the new name passes.
- **Changesets:** `@object-ui/app-shell` **`minor`**, with a breaking note naming the migration (`AppShellProps` → `MinimalAppShellProps`, TS2305 on the old import); `@object-ui/data-objectstack` `patch`. ⛔ No `major`.
- **Round-2 gates at `3e1e1375a`:**
  - the gate: 11 of 11 pass;
  - `check:doc-snippets`: 785 of 785 blocks judged, 0 failed. `check:readme-exports` is OK;
  - layout, the barrel readers, the console and the doc scripts: 48 files and 686 tests passed;
  - the app-shell and layout type-checks and `type-check:scripts` exit 0;
  - ablation S3 (stale) and F3 (fresh) went red as predicted, with restores proven blob-equal;
  - CI: 43 runs, 40 success, 3 skipped, 0 failure.
- **Contract review:** `6092685938` on this PR, **PASS**.

This PR has no closing keyword. The card stays open for later batches.

## What each converged row was (measured on base `d758f2f2`)

The member lists come from one TypeScript program over each package's BUILT root entry (`exports["."].types`), with dist rebuilt for each tree.

**`MetadataTypeStatus`: one status declared twice, so app-shell re-points at react.**

| site | declaration | role | built entry |
|---|---|---|---|
| `packages/react/src/context/AppShellContext.tsx` | `'idle'`, `'loading'`, `'ready'`, `'error'` | what `MetadataContextValue.getTypeStatus` returns | exported at the react root, through its `export *` of `context` |
| `packages/app-shell/src/providers/MetadataProvider.tsx` | the same four literals | what each per-type cache entry of `MetadataProvider` carries; the provider is what implements `getTypeStatus` | exported at the app-shell root |

The two unions are identical. app-shell depends on `@object-ui/react` and already imports `MetadataTypeStatus` from it in `useObjectPresence`, so react's declaration is the one authority. `MetadataProvider.tsx` now imports the type from `@object-ui/react` and re-exports it, and the app-shell root still publishes the name.

**`UserDataAdapter`: one contract declared twice, so app-shell re-points at data-objectstack.**

| site | members | role | built entry |
|---|---|---|---|
| `packages/data-objectstack/src/userState.ts` | generic over `T`: `load()` returns a Promise of `T[]`, `save(items: T[])` returns a Promise of `void` | what `createObjectStackUserStateAdapter` returns | exported at the data-objectstack root |
| `packages/app-shell/src/context/UserStateAdapters.tsx` | the same two members, the same type parameter | what `UserStateAdaptersProvider` injects and `useUserStateAdapter` hands out | exported at the app-shell root |

The members are identical, and `ConsoleShell` attaches adapters built by `createObjectStackUserStateAdapter` to the registry, so both ends already speak one contract. app-shell depends on `@object-ui/data-objectstack`, and the reverse edge would be a package cycle, so data-objectstack's declaration is the one authority. It takes app-shell's contract notes as JSDoc (safe to call concurrently, never throw, degrade to localStorage), so the declaration that remains still documents the contract. `UserStateAdapters.tsx` imports it and re-exports it, and the app-shell root still publishes the name.

## Published surface, base vs head

One TypeScript program per tree over the built root entries of app-shell, react, data-objectstack and layout. Each head marker was read in dist before measuring, and the base tree was built from the three touched source files at base (restored afterwards with blob equality to HEAD).

- **Exported name sets:** app-shell 258 = 258 (same sorted-name hash), react 300 = 300, data-objectstack 104 = 104, layout 37 = 37.
- **The two names:** at head, app-shell's `MetadataTypeStatus` resolves to react's declaration and its `UserDataAdapter` to data-objectstack's: the same symbol, not a structural copy. The member lists are identical on base and head.
- **Emitted output:** base and head dist for the four packages have the same 1,203 files, and exactly four differ, all declaration files: app-shell `providers/MetadataProvider.d.ts` and `context/UserStateAdapters.d.ts`, and data-objectstack `index.d.ts` and `index.d.cts` (JSDoc only). No `.js`, `.cjs` or `.css` file differs, so no first-load bytes move.
- **Why there are three commits:** the first head build emitted `MetadataProvider.js` with one extra comma, because a multi-line import that ended in a type-only specifier and a trailing comma kept that comma after tsc elided the type specifiers. The third commit puts the import back on one line, and the rebuilt `MetadataProvider.js` is byte-identical to base.

## The stopped row: `AppShellProps` (round 1; ruled A in `6092402348` and implemented in round 2)

Measured on base and head (this PR does not touch either site).

| site | members | meaning | read through the entry by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `packages/app-shell/src/types.ts` | `sidebar?`, `header?`, `footer?`, `children`, `className?` | the props of app-shell's minimal `AppShell` container (header, body and footer, no routing). The example `examples/byo-backend-console` mounts it, and the root README, app-shell's README and `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` teach it | `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, which imports the type in two blocks that `check:doc-snippets` compiles (no fragment marker on the page) |
| `packages/layout/src/AppShell.tsx` | `sidebar?`, `navbar?`, `children`, `className?`, `defaultOpen?`, `branding?`, `rightRail?` | the props of layout's sidebar shell, the one the console's `ConsoleLayout` composes | no import through the entry in the repo. layout's README table, `content/docs/layout/app-shell.mdx` and `content/docs/guide/layout.md` document it; seven layout test files name it, and three of them read its key list out of the source by name to pin those docs |

They share `sidebar`, `children` and `className`. `header` and `footer` exist only on app-shell's; `navbar`, `defaultOpen`, `branding` and `rightRail` only on layout's. `@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0 has 0 files naming `AppShellProps`. Three layout test files already warn that app-shell exports a different `AppShellProps` (two of them that it declares `header`), so that layout's docs stop teaching a `header` prop layout never had (objectui#4817).

- **Re-point probe** (the one dependency-legal direction, app-shell to layout, through `ablation-replace`): app-shell's `tsc --noEmit` exits 2 with 2 errors, TS2339 for `header` and TS2339 for `footer` in app-shell's `AppShell`. The unmutated control exits 0 with 0 errors. So this is two meanings, not drift.
- **Rename probe** (option A below, app-shell's declaration renamed `MinimalAppShellProps` and published at the app-shell root instead, four nested `ablation-replace` legs): app-shell builds, and `check:doc-snippets` judges 785 of 785 blocks with 2 failed, both in `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`: TS2305, `Module '"@object-ui/app-shell"' has no exported member 'AppShellProps'.` Every leg was restored blob-equal to HEAD and app-shell dist was rebuilt.

Options:

- **A (recommended).** Rename app-shell's declaration to a specific name and publish that name at the app-shell root in place of `AppShellProps` (258 = 258 names). `MinimalAppShellProps` follows the component's own JSDoc ("Minimal layout container"); `BasicAppShellProps` follows its README entry. It needs `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` (the two blocks) on the file surface, and re-points the layout test comments that say app-shell exports a different `AppShellProps`. app-shell `minor` with a breaking note; an external import of the old name fails loudly (TS2305, measured).
- **B.** Rename layout's side. It is the general shell, the one the console composes, and it has the wider documentation surface: the README table, two content pages and the seven layout test files that name it would move, and the general name would end up on the narrower container.
- **C.** Re-point app-shell's name at layout's. It does not compile (the probe above), and it would silently change what the app-shell root's name means. Refused, as batch 5 refused the same shape.
- **D.** Retire app-shell's minimal `AppShell` and its props. They are live (the example app and three docs), and removing a component is outside "types and comments only".

## Changesets

| file | grade | why |
|---|---|---|
| `6349-batch9-app-shell.md` | `minor` (round 2) | `AppShellProps` leaves the root and `MinimalAppShellProps` takes its place, with a breaking note naming the migration. `MetadataTypeStatus` and `UserDataAdapter` stay, each now a re-export. |
| `6349-batch9-data-objectstack.md` | `patch` | JSDoc only on the published `UserDataAdapter`. |

react and layout are not touched, so they get no changeset. *(Round 1: nothing published moved, so no package took `minor`. Round 2: the app-shell root swaps one name, so app-shell takes `minor`.)* `Clause-②: yes` stands for the batch: the `AppShellProps` row, once ruled, moves a published name. ⛔ No `major`.

## Gates

Heavy runs went through `os-verify-lock`. All runs are at head `fbf9e70bf` unless they say otherwise; the first two commits carry the same sources except the one-line import.

- **The gate**, `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts`: exit 0, `Tests 11 passed (11)`. The ledger has 11 rows.
- **Suites:** `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over `packages/app-shell/src/context/`, `packages/app-shell/src/providers/`, the four app-shell tests elsewhere that import `UserDataAdapter` or `MetadataTypeStatus` or the adapters module (`useTrackRouteAsRecent`, `sharedUserFeeds.activityGate-7476`, `useNavigationSync`, `UnifiedSidebar.pinnedOrder-12059`) plus `consoleUserPreferenceBudget`, `packages/data-objectstack/` and the gate: exit 0, `Test Files 117 passed (117)`, `Tests 1443 passed (1443)`.
- **Type-checks**, with dist rebuilt and the script names echoed: `pnpm --filter PKG type-check` for `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/data-objectstack`, `@object-ui/react` and `@object-ui/console` (the console imports `MetadataTypeStatus` from app-shell), then `pnpm type-check:scripts`: each exit 0, 0 `error TS` lines. `tsconfig.scripts.json` lists the gate file.
- `check:doc-snippets`: 785 of 785 blocks judged, 0 failed, after its own scoped build. `check:readme-exports`: OK, 582 of 582 self-imports real.
- Each exit 0: `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check-changeset-presence` (3 source files of 2 released packages, 2 changesets), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed` and `check-changeset-overwrite`.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the four touched TS files: 0 errors. The 65 warnings sit on unchanged code and match base rule by rule in each file.
- The governed-queue guard reads NOT GOVERNED over the 6 paths.
- `git merge-tree` against `main` `d758f2f2` is clean. `main` has not moved since the base.

Not run locally:

- **The full app-shell suite.** CI runs it.
- **layout's type-check and suite.** layout is not touched on this head.
- **The i18n gates.** No locale pack changed.

## Reverse verification

Every leg went through `ablation-replace` in wrap mode, with predictions written before any leg ran. The gate reads source text, so no dist leg applies. Each leg landed on disk (anchor count 1 to 0, blob changed) and was restored with blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`; the tree had 0 porcelain lines after the run.

| leg | mutation | result (as predicted) |
|---|---|---|
| S1 | the `MetadataTypeStatus` row put back | `Tests 1 failed, 10 passed`; `no longer collides at:` lists app-shell's `MetadataProvider.tsx` and react's `AppShellContext.tsx` |
| S2 | the `UserDataAdapter` row put back | same verdict; lists app-shell's `UserStateAdapters.tsx` and data-objectstack's `userState.ts` |
| F1 | app-shell declares `MetadataTypeStatus` again instead of re-exporting it | `MetadataTypeStatus — a NEW colliding name`: a type declaration in each of the two files |
| F2 | app-shell declares `UserDataAdapter` again instead of re-exporting it | `UserDataAdapter — a NEW colliding name`: an interface declaration in each of the two files |
| control | unmutated, before and after the legs | `Tests 11 passed (11)` |

The failing test in every leg is "declares no name twice outside the named, shrinking baseline".

## Acceptance notes

- **Exports.** Round 2 swaps `AppShellProps` for `MinimalAppShellProps` on the app-shell root (258 = 258). Otherwise, both re-pointed names were already on the app-shell root and stay there; the authorities were already on the react and data-objectstack roots.
- **Comment pointers, not touched (outside the claim's file surface).** The `SharedFeedStatus` doc in `sharedUserFeeds.ts` and the `HomeInboxStatus` doc in `useHomeInbox.ts` cite `MetadataTypeStatus` as living in `providers/MetadataProvider`. That module still exports the name, now as a re-export, so the pointer still resolves; the declaration itself is react's.
- **Value names.** Both app-shell and layout also publish a component named `AppShell`. Component names are outside this gate's bound (type-level names only), and the `AppShellProps` ruling may want to say whether the component follows the props.
- **Build-mode noise, observed once.** The first, fresh head build printed the inferred `render()` return type in app-shell's `ErrorBoundary.d.ts` with its union members in a different order from the incremental base build; the incremental head rebuild matched base. Same members either way, a declaration file only, and no source change answers to it.
